name: The Seven Planetary Deities of Harran (al-Aṣnām al-Sabʿa)
note: Collective hub for the seven planetary gods venerated by the Harranian Sabians, each with its own temple and planetary metal/color/day; attested in Ibn al-Nadim's Fihrist and analyzed in Green, City of the Moon God.

name: Shamash (the Sun) of Harran
note: The Sun-deity of the Harranian heptad, continuing Mesopotamian Shamash and identified with Helios; attested via Ibn al-Nadim and analyzed in Green.

name: Sin (the Moon) of Harran [Sabian cult-phase]
note: The Moon-god, supreme deity of Harran whose great temple (E-hulhul) defined the city's identity; the Sabian planetary continuation of the older Aramean/Mesopotamian Sin. Wired to the existing ENT_ARA_SIN_HARRAN and ENT_MES_NANNA_SIN rather than duplicating them.

name: Kronos (Saturn) of Harran
note: Saturn-deity of the heptad, identified with Greek Kronos and Mesopotamian Ninurta/Ninib; black-clad rites attested in the Fihrist and Green.

name: Zeus (Jupiter / Bel) of Harran
note: Jupiter-deity, identified with Zeus/Bel-Marduk; benefic planet of the heptad per Ibn al-Nadim and Green.

name: Ares (Mars / Nergal) of Harran
note: Mars-deity of the heptad, identified with Greek Ares and Mesopotamian Nergal; malefic planet with red-tinged blood rites described in the Fihrist and Green.

name: Aphrodite (Venus / Ishtar) of Harran
note: Venus-deity of the heptad, the planet al-Zuhra, identified with Greek Aphrodite and Mesopotamian Ishtar; lesser benefic per the Fihrist and Green.

name: Hermes-Nabu (Mercury) of Harran
note: Mercury-deity of the heptad, identified with Greek Hermes and Mesopotamian Nabu; in Harranian thought the planetary Mercury blurs into the prophet-sage Hermes Trismegistus. Distinct entity from the prophet-sage ENT_HRN_HERMES_TRISMEGISTUS below.

name: Hermes Trismegistus (=Idris) as Harranian Prophet-Sage
note: The Harranian Sabians claimed Hermes (identified with Qur'anic Idris/Enoch) as their prophet and Hermetic writings as scripture, a claim that legitimized them under Islam; documented by Ibn al-Nadim and analyzed in Green. Wired by reception_of to existing ENT_HER_TRISMEGISTUS and equated_with ENT_ISL_IDRIS.

name: Agathodaimon as Harranian Prophet-Sage
note: Agathodaimon ('Good Spirit'), paired with Hermes in Hermetic literature, is named alongside Hermes as a prophet/teacher of the Harranian Sabians in the Fihrist tradition; lesser-attested than Hermes. Same figure as the existing pan-Hermetic ENT_LAT_AGATHOS_DAIMON_HERMETIC ('Agathos Daimon'), to which this Harranian-reception entity is wired (homonym/reception, not a duplicate).

name: The Planetary Ascent of the Soul (Harranian)
note: Hermetic-derived Harranian doctrine that the purified soul ascends through the seven planetary spheres, shedding each planet's qualities, to return to its celestial origin; the conceptual link between the planetary cult and Hermetic philosophy per Green and the Corpus Hermeticum (esp. CH I, Poimandres).

name: The Planetary Temples of Harran (Buyut al-Kawakib)
note: The set of temples assigned to each planet, reportedly built in distinctive geometric forms (e.g. the round/square/triangular houses) keyed to each planet, described in the Fihrist and Picatrix-related traditions and analyzed in Green.
